name: Helrift
description:
About This Game

Two Towns. One magical Rift. War is the only constant.

Helrift is a gritty MMORPG with old-school intensity, where two towns battle for territory, resources, and the very essence that is slowly poisoning the world.

Choose Your Allegiance: Take up arms for one of two warring factions, each with unique history and purpose.

Faction Warfare: Engage in tactical PvP across contested zones.

A World of Conflict: Hunt monsters and experience massive, scheduled server-wide events where the Towns clash for dominance and reap the rewards.

Build a Legend: Define your own combat style by shaping your stats, equipment, and skills. From battle mages to pure warriors, archers and agile, mana-infused scouts. Adapt your build to play your way.

A Living Economy: Create, find, buy, and sell essential gear as a specialized crafter, a travelling merchant, or a warrior looting fallen monsters and player enemies.

Legends are not born, they are made.
short_desc: Experience old-school MMORPG intensity in Helrift, where two towns clash. Battle for dominance in server-wide events, master a classless stat and skill-based progression system, and engage in high-stakes open-world PvP. Forge your path through crafting, trading, and tactical combat.
